'''An Outstanding Partner''' is the permanent [[Combat Bangboo]] [[Signal Search]] with no time limit. 

==Rules==
* '''A-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any A-Rank (or above) signal within 9 signal searches in a row, the 10th signal is ''guaranteed'' to be an A-Rank (or higher) signal. <!--(On guarantee, the probability of getting an A-Rank item is 99.4%, and the probability of getting an S-Rank item is 0.6%.)-->
* '''S-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any S-Rank signal after 79 signal searches, the 80th signal search is ''guaranteed'' to be an S-Rank signal. <!--(''On average'', a greater proportion of S-Rank items are dropped between 74 and 90 pity.)-->
** This counter will reset if the player obtains any S-Rank signal.
** Bangboo Channel does not contain S-Rank W-Engines or Agents in their item pool, as such each S-Rank signal will be a Combat Bangboo.
* '''Selected S-Rank Bangboo guarantee:''' Before signal searching on the Bangboo Channel, players need to select one S-Rank Bangboo. Every time a player obtains an S-Rank signal, it is guaranteed to be the previously selected S-Rank Bangboo. 
* '''Counter and Guarantee carry-over:''' Once an S-Rank Bangboo is selected, players can switch targets to a different S-Rank Bangboo without resetting the number of signal searches, thus retaining the guarantee.
